The boy holds a wooden block and a carving knife, gesturing animatedly while talking. The background shows simplified figures of other students and classroom windows. (2) A close-up view focuses on the boy's hands as he aggressively uses the carving tool on the wood. Suddenly, the knife slips and stabs into his left palm. A bright red blood effect appears and begins to spread. (3) The boy's facial expression shifts to extreme agony and shock with wide eyes and a gaping mouth. His skin tone transitions from white to a pale blue-grey hue, and large sweat droplets are illustrated around his head. (4) The scene cuts to a hallway outside the classroom. The boy staggers out, clutching his hand, and collapses face-down onto the floor. A pool of red blood forms around him. The girl and other classmates are seen watching through the classroom windows or standing nearby in shock.
